plugins.name: multi-reviewer
plugins.description: Multi-agent CROSS-VALIDATION protocol for already-drafted plans / already-written code. Does NOT generate plans or code — use superpowers (brainstorming/writing-plans/TDD) for that, then return here for review. 1 main implementer + N independent reviewers (default 2). Five entry modes: product / tech / test / rollout plan review + post-coding QA regression, with N-way double-blind, B1 single-reviewer exception for product plans, multi-repo single-source prompt.
